adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` will throw on invalid body shape, and the decrypted `keys` are processed via `symmetricDecrypt(...)` and `JSON.parse(...)` without any try/catch. Any Zod parse error, decryption error (wrong key/ciphertext), or JSON parse error will bubble up and be handled by Next.js as an unhandled exception, resulting in a 500 response rather than a client-error 4xx. This is directly visible around the request parsing and decrypt/parse steps.
